question: What is the average forecasted annual sales for products 4160 and 7790 during 2018, using monthly sales data starting from January 2016 for the first 36 months, applying seasonality adjustments from time steps 7 through 30, and employing a weighted regression method to estimate sales?

WITH monthly_data AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    TRY_CAST(mth AS DATE) as parsed_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mth) as time_step,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(mth AS DATE)) as month_of_year,
    qty
  FROM monthly_sales 
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
seasonality_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    month_of_year,
    AVG(qty) as avg_qty_for_month
  FROM monthly_data
  WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
  GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT product_id, AVG(avg_qty_for_month) as overall_avg FROM seasonality_calc GROUP BY product_id
),
seasonality_factors AS (
  SELECT 
    ma.product_id,
    ma.month_of_year,
    ma.avg_qty_for_month / oa.overall_avg as seasonality_factor
  FROM seasonality_calc ma
  JOIN overall_avg oa ON ma.product_id = oa.product_id
),
weighted_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(time_step) as sum_w,
    SUM(time_step * time_step) as sum_wx2,
    SUM(time_step * qty) as sum_wy,
    SUM(time_step * time_step * qty) as sum_wxy
  FROM monthly_data
  GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    sum_wx2 / sum_w as weighted_mean_x,
    sum_wy / sum_w as weighted_mean_y,
    (sum_wxy - sum_w * (sum_wx2 / sum_w) * (sum_wy / sum_w)) / 
    (sum_wx2 - sum_w * (sum_wx2 / sum_w) * (sum_wx2 / sum_w)) as weighted_slope,
    weighted_mean_y - weighted_slope * weighted_mean_x as weighted_intercept
  FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT 
    r.product_id,
    md.time_step,
    md.month_of_year,
    r.weighted_slope * md.time_step + r.weighted_intercept as forecasted_sales
  FROM regression r
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT product_id, time_step, month_of_year FROM monthly_data 
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 25 AND 36
  ) md
  WHERE r.product_id = md.product_id
),
adjusted_forecast AS (
  SELECT 
    f.product_id,
    f.time_step,
    f.month_of_year,
    f.forecasted_sales * sf.seasonality_factor as adjusted_forecast
  FROM forecast f
  JOIN seasonality_factors sf ON f.product_id = sf.product_id AND f.month_of_year = sf.month_of_year
),
annual_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(adjusted_forecast) as forecasted_annual_sales
  FROM adjusted_forecast
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
  product_id,
  forecasted_annual_sales,
  ROUND(forecasted_annual_sales, 2) as forecasted_annual_sales_rounded
FROM annual_sales
ORDER BY product_id

  GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    sum_wx2 / sum_w as weighted_mean_x,
    sum_wy / sum_w as weighted_mean_y,
    (sum_wxy - sum_w * (sum_wx2 / sum_w) * (sum_wy / sum_w)) / 
    (sum_wx2 - sum_w * (sum_wx2 / sum_w) * (sum_wx2 / sum_w)) as weighted_slope,
    weighted_mean_y - weighted_slope * weighted_mean_x as weighted_intercept
  FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast AS (
  SELECT 
    r.product_id,
    md.time_step,
    md.month_of_year,
    r.weighted_slope * md.time_step + r.weighted_intercept as forecasted_sales
  FROM regression r
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT product_id, time_step, month_of_year FROM monthly_data 
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 25 AND 36
  ) md
  WHERE r.product_id = md.product_id
),
adjusted_forecast AS (
  SELECT 
    f.product_id,
    f.time_step,
    f.month_of_year,
    f.forecasted_sales * sf.seasonality_factor as adjusted_forecast
  FROM forecast f
  JOIN seasonality_factors sf ON f.product_id = sf.product_id AND f.month_of_year = sf.month_of_year
),
annual_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    SUM(adjusted_forecast) as forecasted_annual_sales
  FROM adjusted_forecast
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
  product_id,
  forecasted_annual_sales,
  ROUND(forecasted_annual_sales, 2) as forecasted_annual_sales_rounded
FROM annual_sales
ORDER BY product_id
